_comment: Backend configuration for E0029-QWEN. Read by the notebook; never hard-coded in a cell.
_revision_note: Pinned to a commit SHA by the notebook at run time and recorded in environment.json. 'main' here is the request; the resolved SHA is what provenance stores.

generation._max_new_tokens_note: Evidence-based, not a guess. Local MLX preflight over 100 samples: median 212, p95 1128, max 2048, truncation 2.0%. The ceiling is re-measured in Colab because a different runtime and precision change the distribution.
generation._thinking_note: Qwen3 emits chain-of-thought in <think> tags by default. On real LiveCodeBench prompts it consumed the entire budget without emitting code: 3/3 sampled problems truncated at 3072 tokens, projecting 191 hours. Disabling it gave median 212 tokens. This flag is the single most consequential setting in the file.

_budget_levels_note: Used by the value-vs-budget curve. If utility does not rise across these, the reasoning engine cannot repay allocation and Governor testing stops.
